description: Machine-readable CLI exit code contract for Schema Forge. Used by CI and tooling to interpret process exit codes.

exitCodes.name: SUCCESS
exitCodes.description: Successful operation; no changes or no destructive operations detected.

exitCodes.name: VALIDATION_ERROR
exitCodes.description: Validation or general error: invalid DSL syntax, config errors, missing files, or operation declined (e.g. destructive changes with --safe).

exitCodes.name: DRIFT_DETECTED
exitCodes.description: Drift detected between expected state (state.json) and live database schema.

exitCodes.name: CI_DESTRUCTIVE
exitCodes.description: Destructive operations detected in CI environment without --force.
